tools.name: risetive_find_competitors
tools.description: Find the existing software products that already do what an idea, a product name or a website does — the same search as risetive.com/find. Use this first when the user asks who the competitors or alternatives are, or whether something already exists. Returns a one-sentence answer (how many products

tools.name: risetive_get_product_profile
tools.description: Read one listed software product by its domain: what it does, its main features, monthly visits (global and US), Domain Rank, backlinks, pricing (paid/free/gated, starting price, model) and its niche with its rank there. Use it after risetive_find_competitors or risetive_list_niche_players to look a

tools.name: risetive_find_niches
tools.description: Find up to five niches (groups of products buyers compare with each other) whose name or definition matches a short text, with each niche's product count, total and median monthly visits, top-three share, share of paid products and visit trend. Use it to get a niche slug for risetive_list_niche_play

tools.name: risetive_list_niche_players
tools.description: List up to eight leading products in one niche — current top products first, then by monthly visits — each with its one-line description, monthly visits, Domain Rank, referring domains and pricing. Use it to see who leads a niche; use risetive_list_new_entrants for the newest products in it. No pagi

tools.name: risetive_list_new_entrants
tools.description: List up to ten products most recently added to Risetive in one niche, newest first, with the same fields as risetive_list_niche_players and when each was added. Use it to see who just entered a niche; the added date is when Risetive listed the product, not its launch date. Works without signing in (

tools.name: risetive_search_jev_projects
tools.description: Match one developer need to up to five open projects, libraries and tools in the Jev catalog (risetive.com/jev), each with what it is for, its category, project link and license when verified. Use it for building blocks a developer would adopt, not for competing products — use risetive_find_competit

tools.name: risetive_list_new_jev_projects
tools.description: List up to ten projects most recently added to the Jev catalog, newest first, with the same fields as risetive_search_jev_projects and when each was added. Use it to see what is new in Jev; to match a specific need, use risetive_search_jev_projects. Requires signing in with a free Risetive account.

tools.name: risetive_save_item
tools.description: Save a niche, a product or a Jev project to the signed-in user's Risetive Saved list (risetive.com/saved). Pass kind and key: kind "market" with a niche slug as key, kind "product" with a product id (from risetive_get_product_profile, risetive_list_niche_players or risetive_list_new_entrants) as key

tools.name: risetive_list_saved_items
tools.description: List the niches, products and Jev projects the signed-in user saved, with each item's id (pass it as savedItemId to risetive_remove_saved_item). Only the user's own items. Requires signing in with a free Risetive account.

tools.name: risetive_remove_saved_item
tools.description: Remove one item from the signed-in user's Saved list by the id that risetive_save_item or risetive_list_saved_items returns; the niche, product or project itself is not affected. Removing an item that is already gone returns removed: false. Requires signing in with a free Risetive account.
